assertion_review.157: Fails if supervision defers without publishing the reload request; that request must prevent entry to the next stale pass.

assertion_review.165: Fails if a completed original pass never leads to replacement on the next supervisor cycle.
assertion_review.166 _wait: Fails by bounded timeout if the recorded replacement never begins its first pass.
assertion_review.167: Fails if the independently running replacement reads the old code-stamp file value; although the fixture supplies the new file content, this checks a child observation rather than echoing an argument from a mocked return.
assertion_review.168: Fails if the original service enters a second pass despite the pending reload request.
